description: Curated OpenCPN resource expectations for the Chart 1-inspired day/standard scene

features.note: Area lookup uses the symbolized land-area table with AC(LANDA) and TX(OBJNAM,...).
The fixed scene uses line geometry, while the OpenCPN chartsymbols bundle exposes FAIRWY as area lookups in the plain and symbolized tables.
Traditional mode with no BOYSHP/COLOUR attributes falls back to the generic paper buoy symbol.
Traditional point wreck rendering comes from the paper table conditional CS(WRECKS02).
